title: euodia lepta
intro: Euodia lepta, commonly known as Chinese rowan or Chinese rowanberry, is a plant species native to China. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Euodia lepta include analgesic and anti-oxidative effects, which can help to alleviate pain and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Euodia lepta include lignans, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
